about: Graphviz's documented style vocabulary, read from graphviz.org by graphviz_vocabulary.py; graphviz.py builds the DOT specimen sheets from it and checks that every entry is drawn or listed as not drawn, with the reason.

attributes.name: _background
attributes.notes: A string in the xdot format specifying an arbitrary background.

attributes.name: area
attributes.notes: Indicates the preferred area for a node or empty cluster. patchwork only.

attributes.name: arrowhead
attributes.notes: Style of arrowhead on the head node of an edge.

attributes.name: arrowsize
attributes.notes: Multiplicative scale factor for arrowheads.

attributes.name: arrowtail
attributes.notes: Style of arrowhead on the tail node of an edge.

attributes.name: bb
attributes.notes: Bounding box of drawing in points. write only.

attributes.name: beautify
attributes.notes: Whether to draw leaf nodes uniformly in a circle around the root node in sfdp.. sfdp only.

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.notes: Canvas background color.

attributes.name: center
attributes.notes: Whether to center the drawing in the output canvas.

attributes.name: charset
attributes.notes: Character encoding used when interpreting string input as a text label..

attributes.name: class
attributes.notes: Classnames to attach to the node, edge, graph, or cluster's SVG element. svg only.

attributes.name: cluster
attributes.notes: Whether the subgraph is a cluster.

attributes.name: clusterrank
attributes.notes: Mode used for handling clusters. dot only.

attributes.name: color
attributes.notes: Basic drawing color for graphics, not text.

attributes.name: colorscheme
attributes.notes: A color scheme namespace: the context for interpreting color names.

attributes.name: comment
attributes.notes: Comments are inserted into output.

attributes.name: compound
attributes.notes: If true, allow edges between clusters. dot only.

attributes.name: concentrate
attributes.notes: If true, use edge concentrators.

attributes.name: constraint
attributes.notes: If false, the edge is not used in ranking the nodes. dot only.

attributes.name: Damping
attributes.notes: Factor damping force motions.. neato only.

attributes.name: decorate
attributes.notes: Whether to connect the edge label to the edge with a line.

attributes.name: defaultdist
attributes.notes: The distance between nodes in separate connected components. neato only.

attributes.name: dim
attributes.notes: Set the number of dimensions used for the layout. neato , fdp , sfdp only.

attributes.name: dimen
attributes.notes: Set the number of dimensions used for rendering. neato , fdp , sfdp only.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.notes: Edge type for drawing arrowheads.

attributes.name: diredgeconstraints
attributes.notes: Whether to constrain most edges to point downwards. neato only.

attributes.name: distortion
attributes.notes: Distortion factor for shape = polygon .

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.notes: Specifies the expected number of pixels per inch on a display device. bitmap output, svg only.

attributes.name: edgehref
attributes.notes: Synonym for edgeURL . map, svg only.

attributes.name: edgetarget
attributes.notes: Browser window to use for the edgeURL link. map, svg only.

attributes.name: edgetooltip
attributes.notes: Tooltip annotation attached to the non-label part of an edge. cmap , svg only.

attributes.name: edgeURL
attributes.notes: The link for the non-label parts of an edge. map, svg only.

attributes.name: epsilon
attributes.notes: Terminating condition. neato only.

attributes.name: esep
attributes.notes: Margin used around polygons for purposes of spline edge routing. neato , fdp , sfdp , osage, circo , twopi only.

attributes.name: fillcolor
attributes.notes: Color used to fill the background of a node or cluster.

attributes.name: fixedsize
attributes.notes: Whether to use the specified width and height attributes to choose node size (rather than sizing to fit the node contents).

attributes.name: fontcolor
attributes.notes: Color used for text.

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.notes: Font used for text.

attributes.name: fontnames
attributes.notes: Allows user control of how basic fontnames are represented in SVG output. svg only.

attributes.name: fontpath
attributes.notes: Directory list used by libgd to search for bitmap fonts.

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.notes: Font size, in points , used for text.

attributes.name: forcelabels
attributes.notes: Whether to force placement of all xlabels , even if overlapping.

attributes.name: gradientangle
attributes.notes: If a gradient fill is being used, this determines the angle of the fill.

attributes.name: group
attributes.notes: Name for a group of nodes, for bundling edges avoiding crossings.. dot only.

attributes.name: head_lp
attributes.notes: Center position of an edge's head label. write only.

attributes.name: headclip
attributes.notes: If true, the head of an edge is clipped to the boundary of the head node.

attributes.name: headhref
attributes.notes: Synonym for headURL . map, svg only.

attributes.name: headlabel
attributes.notes: Text label to be placed near head of edge.

attributes.name: headport
attributes.notes: Indicates where on the head node to attach the head of the edge.

attributes.name: headtarget
attributes.notes: Browser window to use for the headURL link. map, svg only.

attributes.name: headtooltip
attributes.notes: Tooltip annotation attached to the head of an edge. cmap , svg only.

attributes.name: headURL
attributes.notes: If defined, headURL is output as part of the head label of the edge. map, svg only.

attributes.name: height
attributes.notes: Height of node, in inches.

attributes.name: href
attributes.notes: Synonym for URL . map, postscript , svg only.

attributes.name: id
attributes.notes: Identifier for graph objects. map, postscript , svg only.

attributes.name: image
attributes.notes: Gives the name of a file containing an image to be displayed inside a node.

attributes.name: imagepath
attributes.notes: A list of directories in which to look for image files.

attributes.name: imagepos
attributes.notes: Controls how an image is positioned within its containing node.

attributes.name: imagescale
attributes.notes: Controls how an image fills its containing node.

attributes.name: inputscale
attributes.notes: Scales the input positions to convert between length units. neato , fdp only.

attributes.name: K
attributes.notes: Spring constant used in virtual physical model. fdp , sfdp only.

attributes.name: label
attributes.notes: Text label attached to objects.

attributes.name: label_scheme
attributes.notes: Whether to treat a node whose name has the form |edgelabel|* as a special node representing an edge label.. sfdp only.

attributes.name: labelangle
attributes.notes: The angle (in degrees) in polar coordinates of the head & tail edge labels..

attributes.name: labeldistance
attributes.notes: Scaling factor for the distance of headlabel / taillabel from the head / tail nodes..

attributes.name: labelfloat
attributes.notes: If true, allows edge labels to be less constrained in position.

attributes.name: labelfontcolor
attributes.notes: Color used for headlabel and taillabel ..

attributes.name: labelfontname
attributes.notes: Font for headlabel and taillabel .

attributes.name: labelfontsize
attributes.notes: Font size of headlabel and taillabel .

attributes.name: labelhref
attributes.notes: Synonym for labelURL . map, svg only.

attributes.name: labeljust
attributes.notes: Justification for graph & cluster labels.

attributes.name: labelloc
attributes.notes: Vertical placement of labels for nodes, root graphs and clusters.

attributes.name: labeltarget
attributes.notes: Browser window to open labelURL links in. map, svg only.

attributes.name: labeltooltip
attributes.notes: Tooltip annotation attached to label of an edge. cmap , svg only.

attributes.name: labelURL
attributes.notes: If defined, labelURL is the link used for the label of an edge. map, svg only.

attributes.name: landscape
attributes.notes: If true, the graph is rendered in landscape mode.

attributes.name: layer
attributes.notes: Specifies layers in which the node, edge or cluster is present.

attributes.name: layerlistsep
attributes.notes: The separator characters used to split attributes of type layerRange into a list of ranges..

attributes.name: layers
attributes.notes: A linearly ordered list of layer names attached to the graph.

attributes.name: layerselect
attributes.notes: Selects a list of layers to be emitted.

attributes.name: layersep
attributes.notes: The separator characters for splitting the layers attribute into a list of layer names..

attributes.name: layout
attributes.notes: Which layout engine to use.

attributes.name: len
attributes.notes: Preferred edge length, in inches. neato , fdp only.

attributes.name: levels
attributes.notes: Number of levels allowed in the multilevel scheme. sfdp only.

attributes.name: levelsgap
attributes.notes: strictness of neato level constraints. neato only.

attributes.name: lhead
attributes.notes: Logical head of an edge. dot only.

attributes.name: lheight
attributes.notes: Height of graph or cluster label, in inches. write only.

attributes.name: linelength
attributes.notes: How long strings should get before overflowing to next line, for text output..

attributes.name: lp
attributes.notes: Label center position. write only.

attributes.name: ltail
attributes.notes: Logical tail of an edge. dot only.

attributes.name: lwidth
attributes.notes: Width of graph or cluster label, in inches. write only.

attributes.name: margin
attributes.notes: For graphs, this sets x and y margins of canvas, in inches.

attributes.name: maxiter
attributes.notes: Sets the number of iterations used. neato , fdp only.

attributes.name: mclimit
attributes.notes: Scale factor for mincross (mc) edge crossing minimizer parameters. dot only.

attributes.name: mindist
attributes.notes: Specifies the minimum separation between all nodes. circo only.

attributes.name: minlen
attributes.notes: Minimum edge length (rank difference between head and tail). dot only.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.notes: Technique for optimizing the layout. neato only.

attributes.name: model
attributes.notes: Specifies how the distance matrix is computed for the input graph. neato only.

attributes.name: newrank
attributes.notes: Whether to use a single global ranking, ignoring clusters. dot only.

attributes.name: nodesep
attributes.notes: In dot , nodesep specifies the minimum space between two adjacent nodes in the same rank, in inches.

attributes.name: nojustify
attributes.notes: Whether to justify multiline text vs the previous text line (rather than the side of the container)..

attributes.name: normalize
attributes.notes: normalizes coordinates of final layout. neato , fdp , sfdp , twopi , circo only.

attributes.name: notranslate
attributes.notes: Whether to avoid translating layout to the origin point. neato only.

attributes.name: nslimit
attributes.notes: Sets number of iterations in network simplex applications. dot only.

attributes.name: nslimit1
attributes.notes: Sets number of iterations in network simplex applications. dot only.

attributes.name: oneblock
attributes.notes: Whether to draw circo graphs around one circle.. circo only.

attributes.name: ordering
attributes.notes: Constrains the left-to-right ordering of node edges.. dot only.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.notes: node shape rotation angle, or graph orientation.

attributes.name: outputorder
attributes.notes: Specify order in which nodes and edges are drawn.

attributes.name: overlap
attributes.notes: Determines if and how node overlaps should be removed. fdp , neato , sfdp , circo , twopi only.

attributes.name: overlap_scaling
attributes.notes: Scale layout by factor, to reduce node overlap.. prism , neato , sfdp , fdp , circo , twopi only.

attributes.name: overlap_shrink
attributes.notes: Whether the overlap removal algorithm should perform a compression pass to reduce the size of the layout. prism only.

attributes.name: pack
attributes.notes: Whether each connected component of the graph should be laid out separately, and then the graphs packed together..

attributes.name: packmode
attributes.notes: How connected components should be packed.

attributes.name: pad
attributes.notes: Inches to extend the drawing area around the minimal area needed to draw the graph.

attributes.name: page
attributes.notes: Width and height of output pages, in inches.

attributes.name: pagedir
attributes.notes: The order in which pages are emitted.

attributes.name: pencolor
attributes.notes: Color used to draw the bounding box around a cluster.

attributes.name: penwidth
attributes.notes: Specifies the width of the pen, in points, used to draw lines and curves.

attributes.name: peripheries
attributes.notes: Set number of peripheries used in polygonal shapes and cluster boundaries.

attributes.name: pin
attributes.notes: Keeps the node at the node's given input position. neato , fdp only.

attributes.name: pos
attributes.notes: Position of node, or spline control points. neato , fdp only.

attributes.name: quadtree
attributes.notes: Quadtree scheme to use. sfdp only.

attributes.name: quantum
attributes.notes: If quantum > 0.0 , node label dimensions will be rounded to integral multiples of the quantum.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.notes: Radius of rounded corners on orthogonal edges.

attributes.name: rank
attributes.notes: Rank constraints on the nodes in a subgraph. dot only.

attributes.name: rankdir
attributes.notes: Sets direction of graph layout. dot only.

attributes.name: ranksep
attributes.notes: Specifies separation between ranks. dot , twopi only.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.notes: Sets the aspect ratio (drawing height/drawing width) for the drawing.

attributes.name: rects
attributes.notes: Rectangles for fields of records, in points . write only.

attributes.name: regular
attributes.notes: If true, force polygon to be regular..

attributes.name: remincross
attributes.notes: If there are multiple clusters, whether to run edge crossing minimization a second time.. dot only.

attributes.name: repulsiveforce
attributes.notes: The power of the repulsive force used in an extended Fruchterman-Reingold. sfdp only.

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.notes: Synonym for dpi .. bitmap output, svg only.

attributes.name: root
attributes.notes: Specifies nodes to be used as the center of the layout. twopi , circo only.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.notes: If rotate=90 , sets drawing orientation to landscape.

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.notes: Rotates the final layout counter-clockwise by the specified number of degrees. sfdp only.

attributes.name: samehead
attributes.notes: Edges with the same head and the same samehead value are aimed at the same point on the head. dot only.

attributes.name: sametail
attributes.notes: Edges with the same tail and the same sametail value are aimed at the same point on the tail.. dot only.

attributes.name: samplepoints
attributes.notes: Gives the number of points used for a circle/ellipse node.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.notes: Scales layout by the given factor after the initial layout. neato , twopi only.

attributes.name: searchsize
attributes.notes: During network simplex, the maximum number of edges with negative cut values to search when looking for an edge with minimum cut value.. dot only.

attributes.name: sep
attributes.notes: Margin to leave around nodes when removing node overlap. fdp , neato , sfdp , osage, circo , twopi only.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.notes: Sets the shape of a node.

attributes.name: shapefile
attributes.notes: A file containing user-supplied node content.

attributes.name: showboxes
attributes.notes: Print guide boxes for debugging. dot only.

attributes.name: sides
attributes.notes: Number of sides when shape =polygon .

attributes.name: size
attributes.notes: Maximum width and height of drawing, in inches.

attributes.name: skew
attributes.notes: Skew factor for shape =polygon .

attributes.name: smoothing
attributes.notes: Specifies a post-processing step used to smooth out an uneven distribution of nodes.. sfdp only.

attributes.name: sortv
attributes.notes: Sort order of graph components for ordering packmode packing..

attributes.name: splines
attributes.notes: Controls how, and if, edges are represented.

attributes.name: start
attributes.notes: Parameter used to determine the initial layout of nodes. neato , fdp , sfdp only.

attributes.name: style
attributes.notes: Set style information for components of the graph.

attributes.name: stylesheet
attributes.notes: A URL or pathname specifying an XML style sheet, used in SVG output. svg only.

attributes.name: tail_lp
attributes.notes: Position of an edge's tail label, in points .. write only.

attributes.name: tailclip
attributes.notes: If true, the tail of an edge is clipped to the boundary of the tail node.

attributes.name: tailhref
attributes.notes: Synonym for tailURL .. map, svg only.

attributes.name: taillabel
attributes.notes: Text label to be placed near tail of edge.

attributes.name: tailport
attributes.notes: Indicates where on the tail node to attach the tail of the edge.

attributes.name: tailtarget
attributes.notes: Browser window to use for the tailURL link. map, svg only.

attributes.name: tailtooltip
attributes.notes: Tooltip annotation attached to the tail of an edge. cmap , svg only.

attributes.name: tailURL
attributes.notes: If defined, tailURL is output as part of the tail label of the edge. map, svg only.

attributes.name: target
attributes.notes: If the object has a URL , this attribute determines which window of the browser is used for the URL.. map, svg only.

attributes.name: TBbalance
attributes.notes: Which rank to move floating (loose) nodes to. dot only.

attributes.name: tooltip
attributes.notes: Tooltip (mouse hover text) attached to the node, edge, cluster, or graph. cmap , svg only.

attributes.name: truecolor
attributes.notes: Whether internal bitmap rendering relies on a truecolor color model or uses. bitmap output only.

attributes.name: URL
attributes.notes: Hyperlinks incorporated into device-dependent output. map, postscript , svg only.

attributes.name: vertices
attributes.notes: Sets the coordinates of the vertices of the node's polygon, in inches. write only.

attributes.name: viewport
attributes.notes: Clipping window on final drawing.

attributes.name: voro_margin
attributes.notes: Tuning margin of Voronoi technique. neato , fdp , sfdp , twopi , circo only.

attributes.name: weight
attributes.notes: Weight of edge.

attributes.name: width
attributes.notes: Width of node, in inches.

attributes.name: xdotversion
attributes.notes: Determines the version of xdot used in output. xdot only.

attributes.name: xlabel
attributes.notes: External label for a node or edge.

attributes.name: xlp
attributes.notes: Position of an exterior label, in points . write only.

attributes.name: z
attributes.notes: Z-coordinate value for 3D layouts and displays.
